q: In a matrix, if row 1 is A B C, row 2 is D E F, row 3 is G H I, which letter is at row 2, column 3?
exp: Row 2: D E F; column 3 = F. Answer: F

q: In a 3x3 letter matrix, which letter is at the center?
exp: Center of 3x3 = row 2, column 2 = E. Answer: E

q: Matrix: Row 1 = A B C, Row 2 = D E F, Row 3 = G H I. Which letter is diagonally opposite to A?
exp: A is at (1,1); diagonally opposite = (3,3) = I. Answer: I

q: Matrix: Row 1 = M A P, Row 2 = E A T, Row 3 = C A B. Which letter appears most frequently?
exp: A appears 3 times (once in each row); others appear once. Answer: A

q: In a 4x4 matrix, how many cells are there in the main diagonal?
exp: Main diagonal of 4x4 has 4 cells. Answer: 4

q: Matrix: Row 1 = P Q R S, Row 2 = T U V W, Row 3 = X Y Z A. Which letter is at row 2, column 1?
exp: Row 2 = T U V W; column 1 = T. Answer: T

q: Matrix: Row 1 = A B C D, Row 2 = E F G H, Row 3 = I J K L, Row 4 = M N O P. Which letter is at row 3, column 3?
exp: Row 3 = I J K L; column 3 = K. Answer: K

q: Matrix: Row 1 = 1 A, Row 2 = 2 B, Row 3 = 3 C. Which letter is in the same row as the number 3?
exp: Row 3 = 3 C; letter = C. Answer: C

q: Matrix: Row 1 = S U N, Row 2 = M O N, Row 3 = F U N. How many distinct letters are in the matrix?
exp: Letters: S, U, N, M, O, F = 6 distinct. Answer: 6

q: Matrix: Row 1 = P A N, Row 2 = C A T, Row 3 = D O G. Which column contains the letter A?
exp: P A N: A at column 2; C A T: A at column 2; D O G: no A. Answer: Column 2

q: Matrix: Row 1 = A B C, Row 2 = D E F, Row 3 = G H I. If you move one step right from E, which letter do you reach?
exp: E is at (2,2); one step right = (2,3) = F. Answer: F

q: Matrix: Row 1 = 1 2 3, Row 2 = 4 5 6, Row 3 = 7 8 9. What is the sum of the corner numbers?
Matrix: Row 1 = A B, Row 2 = C D, Row 3 = E F, Row 4 = G H. Which letter is at row 4, column 2?
exp: Row 4 = G H; column 2 = H. Answer: H

q: Matrix: Row 1 = M A T H, Row 2 = I S F U N. Which letter is at row 1, column 4?
exp: Row 1 = M A T H; column 4 = H. Answer: H

q: Matrix: Row 1 = Z Y X, Row 2 = W V U, Row 3 = T S R. What is the letter at the intersection of the main diagonal?
exp: Main diagonal: (1,1)=Z, (2,2)=V, (3,3)=R; center = V. Answer: V
